title: Two-agent compound interest advisor
request: Build TWO agents: a 'calculator' agent that computes compound interest, and an 'advisor' entry agent. The user writes '<principal> at <rate>% for <years> years' (annual compounding). The advisor asks the calculator agent, then replies 'Final balance: <amount>' (rounded to 2 decimals) with a review card titled 'Lock in this plan?' with an Approve button (selection {"action":"approve"}) and a Reject button (selection {"action":"reject"}). On approve reply 'Plan locked'; on reject reply 'Plan discarded'.
